versions.changelog: 新增 DSF/SACD 格式支持，可通过网易云音乐搜索并注入歌词到 TXXX:LYRICS 标签
DSF/SACD 支持: 修复文件头写入损坏问题，支持 DSF 格式歌词注入 (TXXX:LYRICS)，按 DSF 规范在文件末尾附加 ID3 标签
全部中文化发布。v1.2.0: 歌词搜索优化(无歌手标签时从目录名推断); v1.1.0: 自动歌词注入(网易云+酷狗); v1.0.0: 首发(RAR解压 CUE分轨 GBK编码修复 多CD目录)

Smarter lyric matching: auto-infer artist from directory when FLAC tags are empty, multi-stage search strategy (title+artist -> title+inferred -> title only), improved match quality for fan compilations.
Tested and stable: Netease lyrics working with Roon scroll sync, Kugou fallback, translation support.

Add lyric injection: auto-fetch synced lyrics from Netease Cloud Music (linuxapi, no login) with Kugou fallback. Embed as FLAC LYRICS tag. New CLI flags: --lyrics, --lyrics-only, standalone lyric.py script.
Initial release: RAR extraction, CUE-based WAV splitting, GBK encoding fix for Chinese filenames, multi-CD album organization
